The Top 5 Star Hotels in Los Angeles To Experience Luxury

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 4:55
Instaread

No argument here, we know that the best 5 star hotels are sprinkled all over Los Angeles, but which are the best?  In the mood for a tranquil spa day, a chic rooftop experience, or a lavish suite with all the amenities…yup, these hotels have it, and though you may be forking over some cold hard cash, we promise that a stay at one of these hotels is worth every penny. If you’re ready to book your most luxurious vacay or staycay yet, we have the ultimate guide to the best of the best when it comes to hotels in LA. Get ready to redefine luxury because here are our favorite 5 star hotels in Los Angeles!

Malibu Beach Inn

Address: 22878 Pacific Coast Hwy, Malibu, CA 90265

Price: $800+/ a night

The Malibu Beach Inn is a timeless, upscale escape on the beach (of course). With just 47 rooms and suites, each featuring cozy interiors and balconies that extend over the ocean, it’s an intimate retreat that makes for the perfect getaway. The on-site restaurant sources fresh produce from the renowned One Gun Ranch, and the oceanfront Cure Day Spa offers treatments worthy of Hollywood royalty. For the most breathtaking views, request a room on the third floor—but honestly, you can’t go wrong with any of them.

1 Hotel West Hollywood

Address: 8490 Sunset Blvd, West Hollywood, CA 90069

Price: $450+/ a night

1 Hotel West Hollywood (our top pick!) is a sustainability icon in the heart of WeHo. The eco-chic hotel seamlessly blends nature with luxury. From a hanging garden at the entrance to reclaimed wood furnishings and repurposed ocean plastics, every detail emphasizes environmental consciousness. Not to mention, it smells amazing in the lobby and fresh cookies at check in? Consider us in. The warm cookies definitely make this one of our favorite 5 star hotels in Los Angeles. With sprawling rooftop pool views from downtown to the beach and party vibes up at Harriet’s, it’s a green oasis that feels like a breath of fresh air right on Sunset. 

Maybourne Beverly Hills

Address: 225 N Canon Dr, Beverly Hills, CA 90210

Price: $1,200+/ a night

Nestled in the heart of Beverly Hills’ Golden Triangle, the Maybourne is a classic Beverly Hills 5 star hotel. Formerly the Montage, it’s a magnet for the jet set and Hollywood elite, where sipping a gin martini on the Terrace feels like a European escape—except for the Prada-clad pups that remind you you’re in Beverly Hills. NYC’s favorite Dante Beverly Hills is now serving some of the best cocktails in town too! The 20,000-square-foot spa is a haven of relaxation, with a stunning mineral pool, saunas, and Turkish steam rooms that make unwinding an art form.

Sunset Marquis

Address: 1200 Alta Loma Rd, West Hollywood, CA 90069

Price: $400+/ a night

The Sunset Marquis is a 5 star-ish hotel ( just a few points under) that is nothing short of iconic. It embodies the true essence of rock-and-roll luxury. This year, they’ve unveiled a new spa that’s already making waves for its incredible relaxation and top-tier treatments. With a serene atmosphere and the best massage in town,  what better way to unwind than at a five star hotel in Los Angeles? With new cutting-edge amenities, we might call this a must-visit for anyone seeking an indulgent and historic escape in the heart of West Hollywood.

Santa Monica Proper Hotel

Address: 700 Wilshire Blvd, Santa Monica, CA 90401

Price: $700+/ a night

The Westside has the 5 star hotel it’s been dreaming of. The Santa Monica Proper Hotel is all about coastal cool with a dash of high-energy chic, courtesy of renowned LA designer Kelly Wearstler. Her signature style shines through in every corner, with earth-toned, textured designs that feel effortlessly sophisticated. Think floral wallpapers, sheepskin rugs, and low-slung sofas—all in a perfect sandy palette. It’s the ultimate retreat for techies, creatives, and anyone who loves that laid-back yet luxe LA vibe. If you’re more keen on the east side, be sure to spend a night or two at the Downtown Proper Hotel!

The Beverly Hills Hotel

Address: 9641 Sunset Blvd, Beverly Hills, CA 90210

Price: $900+/ a night

How could we not mention this iconic “Pink Palace” where Old Hollywood meets modern luxury! The Beverly Hills Hotel has a glamorous pool scene and lush gardens that make you feel like you’re living a movie star dream. The suites are pure elegance, offering the ultimate LA experience. Whether you’re lounging by the pool or dining at the Polo Lounge, this is the place to soak in the timeless allure of Beverly Hills.

Since you’re in the luxe mood, dine at one of these Rooftop Restaurants in LA for the best views in the city.
